en: A black and white postcard photograph showing a panoramic view of a hillside city. Prominent in the foreground is a large palace complex on a rocky outcrop, with a mountainous backdrop. The French text at the top identifies the site as the 'Palais du Prince' (Prince's Palace) in Monaco and references the 'Tête de Chien' (a distinctive mountain peak whose name means 'the head of the dog'). There is also English text providing a translation.
